observations.what: Function _turn_from_reply handles multiple reply statuses (ok, refused_by_floor, timeout) and maps them to turn statuses (spoke/anomaly, unavailable, unavailable).
Function _floor_refusal_turn sets status to 'unavailable' and reason to 'transport_error' as placeholders.
Function _budget_turn sets status to 'budget_exhausted' and content empty.
dry_run_plan is a stub with no implementation or docstring; it will cause errors if called.
All three helper functions construct dicts with common keys: actor, vendor, model, independence_class, role, lane, blind, meta.
